releases.name: opencode-shell-magazine v0.1.0
releases.body:
First release.

- Sidebar panel (prepended above the host Context) listing shell commands from the current session and its subagents
- Live status from the host shell registry: running / exited / timeout / killed, exit code, cwd, duration, pid
- Subagent commands are tagged with a `↳ agent` badge
- Header summary `● running ✗ failed/total elapsed`; plugin version shown in muted gray
- Expand an entry for command, cwd, timeout, output file and a tail preview
- Actions: kill a running command, copy the command, open the output file
- Notification when a command finishes (toggle + duration threshold)
- 17 slash commands + native settings menu (`/shell-magazine`); 4 languages
- Optional border, detail toggles and prompt footer indicator

### Install

```bash
npm install -g opencode-shell-magazine
opencode-shell-magazine
```

Restart the TUI after installing.
